title: Northwind Patient Portal: Security Architecture
subtitle: Drawn from the plain-English description in description.md
summary: Patients reach the Patient Portal from the internet through an edge firewall and a WAF in the DMZ. The Portal App runs in its own app zone, checks logins with Okta, and is the only thing allowed to reach patient data and secrets in the data zone. Admins come in through a VPN and a bastion host, and every layer sends its logs to Splunk, which alerts the Security Team.
